integrity: Exact analytic proof accompanies reproducible finite symbolic and quadrature cross-checks; no independent scientific validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only real scalar y'=-lambda y, fixed h>0 and independently repeated two-stage copulas with each marginal uniform. Optimum may depend on z and require a fair coin. No general accuracy or nonlinear stability guarantee. Classical countermonotone rearrangement is known. Earlier equivalent applications remain a precedence risk.
title: Optimal paired-stage coupling extends randomized Runge–Kutta mean-square stability past the midpoint barrier
